name: Gods of Rock! - Reborn
review:
Gods of Rock! - Reborn is a 6-reel rock slot with 466 connecting ways. Wild symbols, reel multipliers, Wild Encores and a feature buy build toward the 20,000x maximum.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 96.05% RTP.

Wild Encores can bring wilds back for another round, and reel multipliers can stack up on the same spin. The Reborn edition keeps the original's stage-show presentation with refreshed visuals.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
